svg.title: Tailnet trust tiers and service exposure
svg.desc: Three client tiers on one Tailnet. Personal devices can SSH into edge nodes and runners, reach all Tailscale Services, and route internet traffic through edge exit nodes. Runners reach important services such as logging. Edge nodes have no internal access. Each Tailscale Service is proxied by tailscaled to a process bound to 127.0.0.1. Service hosts initiate outbound-only connections to external services.
